value.rationale: Equal external immigration is a natural irreducible mainland-island model with nontrivial stationary distributions. A fixed directional colonization budget has mathematically incompatible optimum for regional persistence versus joint occupancy; the strict universal reversal for all positive rates is a useful exact conservation-objective distinction not dictated by an absorbing mean-extinction-time optimization.
